title: Certify a proposed action without learning its hidden matrix
statement: Joint Loewner concavity and Q>=mI imply convex Z=eTQ^-1e, concave G and 0<=Zii<=Mi=||e||²(2Li²/m³+Bi/m²). With reciprocal intervals[a0,b0] at x and[ai,bi] at x+hi ei, use l_i=(a0-bi)/hi-ci, h_i=(b0-ai)/hi-ci+Mi hi/2.

requires: Q>=mI on a neighborhood of sum u<=1/5; joint Loewner concavity, ||Qi||<=Li,||Qii||<=Bi, known ||e||, stable calibrated R=3/2+1/Z and raw error<=1e-8. Separate coordinate forward steps require dose margin and live source/reset access. Monotone actuation is an ADDITIONAL premise for clipping at -cost.

assumptions: Finite success does not establish global concavity. Old matrices or an expired source cannot replace the required live audit.

body: Read n+1 scalar reactions with sum x<=delta-max hi. Reciprocal conversion requires r-epsilon>3/2; otherwise return UNKNOWN. Inversion antitonicity/operator convexity proves shape transfer; integrate the bounded second derivative, then apply U1089-simplex-tangent-regret. General Q need not be affine, rank-one or known-dimensional. Preserve the raw lower endpoint unless a separate monotonicity premise warrants clipping.
